control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console R-2: report detail / adjudication. Host claim vs AI evidence vs delta on the 7 compared metrics; approve, request revision, escalate.

property.name: ReportJson
property.description-key: JSON of ONE [Report - PBS Hub] row (object or one-row array), including ScheduleID, Playbook, Approver, ApproverEmail, ApprovalComment, Attachment, Created, Modified.

property.name: EvidenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report Automation - PBS Hub] for this report (Title = Report.Title, or numeric tail = Report.ID). Several rows allowed: newest wins.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] for the ScheduleID of each report (ID, Title, Date, StartTime, EndTime): shows the live window.

property.name: BrandsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Brand - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaBrand (optional, for the name).

property.name: HostsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaHost (optional, for the name).

property.name: Mode
property.description-key: Admin renders the decision bar; ReadOnly never does.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading the report: renders skeletons.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: APPROVE, APPROVE_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE, REQUEST_REVISION, ESCALATE, REMIND_HOST, OPEN_EVIDENCE, RELOAD, BACK.
